cases.sql:
WITH locally_funded_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        f.cdscode,
        f."School Name" AS school_name,
        s.doctype,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
        f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_5_17,
        (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS enrollment_diff
    FROM public.frpm f
    JOIN public.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
    WHERE f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded'
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
      AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
)
, avg_diff AS (
    SELECT round(avg(enrollment_diff), 2) AS avg_enrollment_diff
    FROM locally_funded_schools
)
SELECT 
    lfs.school_name,
    lfs.doctype,
    lfs.enrollment_diff
FROM locally_funded_schools lfs
CROSS JOIN avg_diff
WHERE lfs.enrollment_diff > avg_diff.avg_enrollment_diff
ORDER BY lfs.enrollment_diff DESC, lfs.school_name

cases.sql:
WITH loan_years AS (
  SELECT 
    l.amount,
    SUBSTRING(l.date, 1, 4)::int AS year
  FROM public.loan l
  JOIN public.account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN public.disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN public.client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'M'
    AND SUBSTRING(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997')
)
, sums AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM loan_years
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  round(
    (COALESCE(s97.total_amount,0) - COALESCE(s96.total_amount,0)) 
    / NULLIF(COALESCE(s96.total_amount,0),0) * 100, 2
  ) AS growth_rate_percent
FROM 
  (SELECT total_amount FROM sums WHERE year = 1996) s96
  FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT total_amount FROM sums WHERE year = 1997) s97 ON true

cases.sql:
WITH abnormal_patients AS (
  SELECT l.id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN l.plt < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_low,
         MAX(CASE WHEN l.plt > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_high
    FROM public.laboratory l
   WHERE l.plt <= 100 OR l.plt >= 400
   GROUP BY l.id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_low = 1) AS patients_with_low_platelet,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_high = 1) AS patients_with_high_platelet,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_low = 1) - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_high = 1) AS difference_low_minus_high
FROM abnormal_patients

WITH member_event_expenses AS (
  SELECT
    e.link_to_member,
    SUM(e.cost) AS total_paid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) AS event_count
  FROM expense e
  JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
  GROUP BY e.link_to_member
),
qualified_members AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, total_paid
  FROM member_event_expenses
  WHERE event_count > 1
)
SELECT
  m.member_id,
  m.first_name,
  m.last_name,
  qm.total_paid
FROM qualified_members qm
JOIN member m ON qm.link_to_member = m.member_id
ORDER BY qm.total_paid DESC
LIMIT 1
